blueprint.source: SSC CGL Tier-I: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes, 25 questions in each of Reasoning, GA, Quant and English; negative 0.50 per wrong answer.

questions.text: Rahul walks 10 km North, turns right and walks 5 km, turns right and walks 10 km, turns left and walks 10 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Calculate Net Displacement. North-South: +10 (N) - 10 (S) = 0. East-West: +5 (E) + 10 (E) = 15 km East. Distance = 15 km (No Pythagoras needed as one axis is zero). Step-by-step: Start (0,0). North 10 -> (0,10). Right (East) 5 -> (5,10). Right (South) 10 -> (5,0). Left (East) 10 -> (15,0). Distance from origin = 15 km.

questions.text: The average speed of a car for the entire journey is 60 km/h. If it covers the first half of the distance at 50 km/h, what is its speed during the second half?
questions.solution: Let total distance be 2d. Time for first half = d/50. Total time required = 2d/60. Time for second half = (2d/60) - (d/50) = d/300. Speed for second half = Distance/Time = d / (d/300) = 72 km/h. Option A is incorrect because average speed is not the arithmetic mean of speeds, and options Cand D do not satisfy the harmonic mean relationship.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers is a tributary of the Godavari River?
questions.solution: Shortcut: River System Elimination: Bhima & Tungabhadra are major tributaries of Krishna; Seonath is a major tributary of Mahanadi. Penganga (Painganga) is a major tributary of Godavari (joins Wardha). Worked Solution: The Godavari basin covers Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha. Its major left-bank tributaries include Penganga, Wardha, and Pranhita. Bhima and Tungabhadra flow into the Krishna River in Karnataka/Telangana. Seonath flows into the Mahanadi in Chhattisgarh.

questions.text: Deficiency of which vitamin leads to Pellagra, a condition classically defined by the '3 Ds': Dermatitis, Diarrhoea, and Dementia (potentially leading to Death)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Pellagra -> 3 Ds (Dermatitis, Diarrhoea, Dementia) -> Vitamin B3 (Niacin). Mnemonic: 'Niacin prevents the 3 Ds'. Beriberi (Wet/Dry) -> B1; Pernicious Anaemia -> B12; Scurvy (bleeding gums) -> C. Full Solution: Pellagra is caused by Niacin (Vitamin B3) deficiency, common in populations relying heavily on maize (corn) diet which is low in tryptophan (niacin precursor). Vitamin B1 deficiency causes Beriberi. Vitamin B12 deficiency causes Megaloblastic/Pernicious Anaemia. Vitamin C deficiency causes Scurvy.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "He is the only son of my mother's mother." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Mother's mother' = Maternal Grandmother. 'Only son' of Grandmother = Mother's Brother = Maternal Uncle. Eliminate Father (Father's father), Brother (Mother's son), Paternal Uncle (Father's brother). Step-by-step: The woman's mother's mother is her maternal grandmother. The only son of the maternal grandmother is the woman's mother's brother, who is the woman's maternal uncle.

questions.text: If \( x + \frac{1}{x} = 5 \), find the value of \( x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} \).
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use identity \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} = (x + \frac{1}{x})^3 - 3(x + \frac{1}{x})\). Substitute \(k=5\): \(5^3 - 3 \times 5 = 125 - 15 = 110\). Step-by-step: Cube the given equation: \((x + \frac{1}{x})^3 = x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} + 3(x + \frac{1}{x})\). \(125 = x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} + 15\). Therefore, \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} = 125 - 15 = 110\).

questions.text: A vessel contains 80 litres of pure milk. 16 litres of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. This process is repeated two more times. What is the quantity of milk (in litres) left in the vessel?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the replacement formula $Final = Initial \times (1 - \frac{Replaced}{Total})^n$. Here, fraction remaining $= 1 - \frac{16}{80} = \frac{4}{5}$, and $n=3$. Milk left $= 80 \times (\frac{4}{5})^3 = 80 \times \frac{64}{125} = 40.96$ litres. Full Method: After 1st replacement, milk $= 80 - 16 = 64$ L. After 2nd, milk removed $= 16 \times \frac{64}{80} = 12.8$ L, remaining $= 51.2$ L. After 3rd, milk removed $= 16 \times \frac{51.2}{80} = 10.24$ L, final milk $= 51.2 - 10.24 = 40.96$ L.

questions.text: The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a certain sum at 10% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 50. Find the principal sum.
questions.solution: Shortcut: For 2 years, Difference (CI - SI) = Principal × (Rate/100)². Substituting values: 50 = P × (10/100)² = P × 1/100 ⇒ P = 50 × 100 = Rs. 5000. Step-by-step: Let Principal = P. SI for 2 years = (P × 10 × 2)/100 = 0.2P. Amount in CI = P(1 + 10/100)² = 1.21P. CI = 1.21P - P = 0.21P. Difference = 0.21P - 0.2P = 0.01P. Given 0.01P = 50, so P = 50/0.01 = Rs. 5000.

questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech for: He said, "I will finish the work tomorrow."

options.label: A
options.text: He said that he would finish the work tomorrow.

options.label: B
options.text: He said that he will finish the work the next day.

options.label: C
options.text: He said that he would finish the work the next day.

options.label: D
options.text: He said that he finishes the work the next day.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Reporting verb 'said' (Past) triggers backshifting: 'will' becomes 'would'; 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'; pronoun 'I' becomes 'he'. Full Solution: Since the reporting verb 'said' is in the past tense, the reported speech undergoes backshifting. The modal 'will' changes to 'would'. The time expression 'tomorrow' changes to 'the next day'. The first-person pronoun 'I' changes to 'he' (matching the subject of the reporting verb). Only Option C applies all three rules correctly.

questions.text: Which of the following changes was NOT effected by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976?

options.label: A
options.text: Addition of words "Socialist", "Secular" and "Integrity" to the Preamble

options.label: B
options.text: Insertion of Fundamental Duties in Part IVA of the Constitution

options.label: C
options.text: Granting primacy to Directive Principles over Fundamental Rights via Article 31C

options.label: D
options.text: Removal of Right to Property from the list of Fundamental Rights

questions.solution: Shortcut: Associate the 42nd Amendment (Mini Constitution) with 'Additions' (Preamble words, Duties, DPSP primacy) and the 44th Amendment (1978) with 'Deletion' (Right to Property removed from Art 31, made legal right under Art 300A). Full Solution: The 42nd Amendment, 1976, added 'Socialist', 'Secular', 'Integrity' to the Preamble; inserted Part IVA (Fundamental Duties); and amended Art 31C to give primacy to all DPSPs over FRs. The Right to Property was deleted from Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978.

questions.text: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'. Each of the participants have received their certificates.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply the 'Each of + Plural Noun' rule: the verb must be singular ('has', not 'have'). Eliminate Option A (subject phrase is correct structure) and Option C (possessive pronoun 'their' is acceptable for singular antecedent in modern usage). Option B contains the verb error. Full Solution: The subject is 'Each' (singular distributive pronoun), followed by the prepositional phrase 'of the participants'. The verb must agree with 'Each', requiring the singular 'has received'. 'Have received' is plural, hence incorrect.

questions.text: Select the number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following series. 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Calculate the differences between consecutive terms: 7−3=4, 15−7=8, 31−15=16, 63−31=32. The differences (4, 8, 16, 32) are powers of 2 doubling each time. The next difference is 64. Add 64 to the last term: 63 + 64 = 127. Step-by-step: The series follows the pattern (Previous Term × 2) + 1. 3×2+1=7; 7×2+1=15; 15×2+1=31; 31×2+1=63; 63×2+1=127. Alternatively, each term is one less than a power of 2 (2^n − 1): 2^2−1=3, 2^3−1=7, 2^4−1=15, 2^5−1=31, 2^6−1=63, 2^7−1=127.

questions.text: Keibul Lamjao National Park, the only floating national park in the world, is located in which Indian state?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Associate 'Floating National Park' uniquely with Keibul Lamjao on Loktak Lake in Manipur, habitat of the Sangai deer. Worked Solution: Keibul Lamjao National Park is situated on the floating biomass (phumdis) of Loktak Lake in Manipur. It was declared a national park in 1977 primarily to protect the endangered Brow-antlered deer (Sangai), the state animal of Manipur.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'SMART' is written as 'TLBQU'. How will 'QUICK' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The pattern alternates between +1 and -1 starting with +1 for the 1st letter (Odd positions: +1, Even positions: -1). Apply only to odd positions (1st, 3rd, 5th) to verify options quickly: Q->R, I->J, K->L. Only Option A matches RTJBL. Step-by-step: S(+1)=T, M(-1)=L, A(+1)=B, R(-1)=Q, T(+1)=U. For QUICK: Q(+1)=R, U(-1)=T, I(+1)=J, C(-1)=B, K(+1)=L. Result: RTJBL.

questions.text: Identify the segment containing the grammatical error: "The teacher asked the students / to listen her carefully / during the lecture / No error"
questions.solution: Shortcut: The verb 'listen' is intransitive and mandatorily requires the preposition 'to' before an object (listen to someone). Spot the missing 'to'. Full Solution: The error lies in the second segment. The verb 'listen' cannot take a direct object; it must be followed by the preposition 'to' when specifying what or who is being heard. The correct phrasing is 'listen to her carefully'. Segment A and C are grammatically correct.
